statement: The University of Florida blueberry breeding programme publishes measured values for Emerald of firmness of 184 to 211 g/mm with an average of 195, average berry weight of 2.4 g, average diameter of 18.4 mm and average soluble solids of 11.3 degrees Brix. The firmness figures use the programme's own g/mm compression index and are not directly comparable with firmness figures produced by other methods.
